speaker: leo
text: Welcome back everyone.

speaker: leo
text: Today I'm joined once again by Eve from Club Madeira.

speaker: leo
text: Eve, thank you for being here.

speaker: eve
text: Always a pleasure, Leo.

speaker: leo
text: So, if I wanted to become a partner — say I'm a website designer or digital agency working with clubs — walk me through what that would look like, especially the white-label side.

speaker: eve
text: That's the part partners love most.

speaker: eve
text: The Smart Catalogue is built from the ground up as a fully white-label product.

speaker: eve
text: Clubs never see Club Madeira branding.

speaker: eve
text: When you embed it, the entire experience appears under your client's brand, on their domain, with their colours, logo and voice.

speaker: eve
text: From the member's point of view it simply feels like the club's own professional online shop.

speaker: eve
text: That's a huge selling point for agencies.

speaker: leo
text: So I control the look and feel completely?

speaker: eve
text: Completely.

speaker: eve
text: You control the branding, the pricing you charge the club, the level of support you offer, and the ongoing client relationship.

speaker: eve
text: We stay in the background.

speaker: eve
text: You deliver a white-labelled Progressive Web App experience that members can even install on their phones — still fully branded as the club.

speaker: leo
text: Can I modify the code myself if I need to?

speaker: eve
text: Yes.

speaker: eve
text: The complete partner integration code is available under the MIT open-source licence.

speaker: eve
text: You're free to use it, modify it, and extend it however you need.

speaker: eve
text: That means you can adapt the widgets, adjust the PWA behaviour, or build additional features on top without asking permission or paying extra.

speaker: eve
text: It's designed so agencies can properly own the technical delivery for their clients.

speaker: leo
text: That makes it feel like a premium service I'm providing, not a locked-down third-party tool.

speaker: eve
text: Exactly.

speaker: eve
text: You're not reselling someone else's platform.

speaker: eve
text: You're embedding a powerful fundraising engine that becomes part of the club's own digital presence.

speaker: eve
text: And because it's white-label and open source under MIT, you can position and customise it however you like.

speaker: leo
text: How does the commercial side work in that model?

speaker: eve
text: When members shop, the club earns commission, you earn recurring revenue, and merchants get targeted exposure.

speaker: eve
text: There are no monthly platform fees.

speaker: eve
text: Your technical work is the clean integration, branding, and any modifications you choose to make.

speaker: eve
text: The ongoing commercial opportunity is driving engagement.

speaker: eve
text: We expect each active catalogue to generate around two thousand clicks a month.

speaker: eve
text: That comes from the marketing, SEO and promotion that you bill the club for as a paid service.

speaker: leo
text: So the white-label nature plus the MIT licence lets me own the whole relationship and charge properly for the value.

speaker: eve
text: That's the model.

speaker: eve
text: You bring the clubs, the websites and the promotional expertise.

speaker: eve
text: We provide the AI, the product vault and the infrastructure — all invisible to the end user.

speaker: eve
text: It turns a simple website add-on into a high-value, recurring service under your brand.

speaker: leo
text: That's very clear.

speaker: leo
text: What's the practical first step if I wanted to start?

speaker: eve
text: You become an approved partner, receive your affiliate code and the full partner package — including the MIT-licensed integration code — then begin embedding the white-label catalogue for your existing club clients.

speaker: eve
text: From day one it looks and feels like something you built for them.

speaker: leo
text: Thank you, Eve.

speaker: leo
text: That's extremely helpful.

speaker: eve
text: Thank you, Leo.

text: Happy to go deeper any time.
